description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Ninja], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Lupine Pulse Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ninja
description.text: Ninja abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Lupine Pulse Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Lupine Pulse after using two Ninja abilities

description.name: Lupine Pulse
description.text: 4/6/8 single attacks (0.67 each) if the user has Physical Blink 0/1/2
